summary: First weekly Liga Portugal report: 10 games (matchday 9 plus Monday's rearranged Braga v Gil Vicente). Main themes: Europe midweek for Porto, Sporting, Benfica and Braga; Gil Vicente's cup extra time; Estoril's sacking. Referees and line-ups aren't out yet, so check the min odds and the team news before betting.

adjustments.reason: New signings Milosevic and Tommy Marques ineligible (not registered on the original August date)
Gil Vicente played 120 minutes in the cup on Saturday (3-2 aet v U. Santarem), two days' rest
Braga winless in three, conceded six in the last two; fans whistled after Copenhagen

factors.market: Braga 1.60, draw 4.00, Gil 5.75, Under 2.5 1.75 (model feed); Braga or draw about 1.15-1.20 estimated
factors.injuries: Braga: no new injuries reported; Milosevic and Tommy Marques ineligible. Gil Vicente: Guilherme Gomes ineligible (new signing, minor role).
factors.fatigue: Braga: Conference League midweek, then Nacional away Sunday (three games in seven days). Gil Vicente: cup extra time Saturday, Porto at home on Saturday.
factors.form: Braga: Sporting 3-1 (L), Copenhagen 3-0 (L), Santa Clara 0-0. Gil Vicente: won at Moreirense, 11 goals in 7 league games.
factors.home_away: Braga at home; Gil Vicente bring a large away following (short Minho derby trip).
factors.manager_news: Vicens under pressure after Copenhagen; Gil Vicente fear Braga's complaints about refereeing.
factors.motivation: Rearranged round-2 derby; both on 11 points, 8th and 9th.
factors.tactics: Gil Vicente compact and low-scoring; Braga dominate the ball but have been open at the back.

risks: Braga's form is poor and their defence has leaked six goals in two games
games.why: Braga are the better side at home, but they are winless in three, conceded six in their last two games and cannot use new signings Milosevic and Tommy Marques, so a straight Braga win at 1.60 (57%) is too shaky. Gil Vicente rarely score (6 goals in 7 games) and are tired after 120 minutes in the cup on Saturday, so their chance of winning is only 18%. The three most likely scores are 1-0, 1-1 and 0-0, and Braga or draw covers all three: 82%. Under 2.5 (55% at 1.75) is the value alternative.
